caption:
The mountain sets the pace; you decide whether to argue. When the gradient tilts upward and the gravel turns loose, the only thing that matters is the rhythm of your own breath. There is no crowd here, no engine, and no schedule. Just the quiet persistence of turning pedals against a landscape that doesn't care how fast you want to go. You learn to listen to the terrain, to find the line that holds, and to let the forest be the only witness to the work.
